codeReview.summary: All 6 deduplication items from the feature description were implemented correctly. The worker extracted shared TOML persistence helpers (load_config_file/save_config_file) used by both Preferences and GuiState, created spawn_primitive_with_color to deduplicate 5 primitive spawning methods, extracted compute_movement_direction() from FlyCameraLookSystem, deduplicated deinterleave_pbr/deinterleave_pbr_skinned with a shared deinterleave_pbr_attributes helper, and extracted build_world_transforms as a shared public function. Material creation was already consistent (compile_material everywhere). Net result: -185 lines across 6 files. Workspace compiles cleanly.

issues.description: There is still a #[cfg(test)]-only duplicate of build_world_transforms in animation/gltf_loader.rs with a slightly different signature (takes an extra parent_map parameter). This could reuse the shared build_world_transforms from modelcache.rs, but the test constructs parent_map externally. Minor residual duplication in test code only.

build_world_transforms is defined with 'use std::collections::{HashMap, VecDeque}' inside the function body, even though HashMap is already imported at the module level. This is not a bug but could be cleaned up for consistency.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly followed the 'no hybrids' convention — when extracting shared helpers, the old duplicated code in consumers was fully removed rather than left alongside the new helpers. This is consistent with AGENTS.md guidelines.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: gui_state.rs and preferences.rs both removed their full file I/O implementations, replacing them with calls to shared load_config_file/save_config_file. No hybrid state remains.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker maintained proper visibility: spawn_primitive_with_color is fn (private) since it's an internal implementation detail, while the public API (spawn_test_cube, spawn_sphere, etc.) remains pub. build_world_transforms is pub since it's used by tests in modelcache.rs. This follows the pub(crate) default convention.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: spawning.rs:11 - fn spawn_primitive_with_color (no pub), modelcache.rs:62 - pub fn build_world_transforms

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature noted pre-existing warnings (unused variables in gltf_loader.rs, unused variable in ui/renderer.rs, dead code in viewport_grid.rs) that were NOT fixed as part of this feature. These may need to be tracked for future cleanup.

summary: The app-deduplication feature was implemented correctly and completely. All 6 deduplication targets were addressed: TOML persistence helpers, primitive spawning, material creation consistency (already consistent), camera movement direction extraction, deinterleave deduplication, and build_world_transforms extraction. The net result is -185 lines of code with no functionality changes. Workspace compiles cleanly. Two minor non-blocking issues noted: a test-only duplicate of build_world_transforms in gltf_loader.rs and a redundant use statement inside the shared build_world_transforms function.
